nodes.title: Column-centred genotype matrix

nodes.summary: The relation between allele frequencies and coalescence times under neutral infinite-sites mutation, taken as the model assumption: the expected heterozygosity between populations `X` and `Y` is `θ` times the expected coalescence time `coalTime X Y` of a gene from `X` and a gene from `Y` (two genes drawn independently, so with replacement, when `X = Y`). Time is in units of `2N` generations and `θ = 4Nu`. The…
nodes.title: Coalescent model linking heterozygosity and coalescence times

nodes.summary: The column mean `(1 / n) ∑ i, Z i s` of locus `s` over the `n` samples.
nodes.title: Column mean of a genotype matrix

nodes.summary: The double centring `t̄ i· + t̄ ·j - t i j - t̄ ··` of a square matrix `t` (row, column and grand means over the `n` indices).
nodes.title: Double centring of a square matrix

nodes.summary: Peter (2016): `f2 A B = π A B - (π A A + π B B) / 2`.
nodes.title: Peter's formula for $f_2$ via expected heterozygosity

nodes.summary: `f2 A B = θ (𝔼 T_AB - (𝔼 T_AA + 𝔼 T_BB) / 2)`.
nodes.title: $f_2$ in terms of expected coalescence times

nodes.summary: `f3 C A B = θ / 2 * (𝔼 T_CA + 𝔼 T_CB - 𝔼 T_AB - 𝔼 T_CC)`.
nodes.title: $f_3$ in terms of expected coalescence times

nodes.summary: `f4 A B C D = θ / 2 * (𝔼 T_AD + 𝔼 T_BC - 𝔼 T_AC - 𝔼 T_BD)`.
nodes.title: $f_4$ in terms of expected coalescence times

nodes.summary: McVean (2009), deterministic form: the covariance of the centred genotype matrix is the double centring of the pairwise-difference matrix, divided by `2 L`.
nodes.title: Genotype covariance as double-centred pairwise differences

nodes.summary: The sample covariance `C i j = (1 / L) ∑ s, X i s * X j s` of the centred genotype matrix `X` over the `L` loci.
nodes.title: Sample covariance of the centred genotype matrix

nodes.summary: The probability `a (1 - b) + b (1 - a)` that a gene from a population with allele frequency `a` and a gene from a population with allele frequency `b` differ at a biallelic site.
nodes.title: Probability that two genes differ at a biallelic site

nodes.summary: `hetPair` of square-integrable frequencies is integrable on a finite measure space.
nodes.title: Integrability of pairwise heterozygosity

nodes.summary: McVean (2009): the expected genotype covariance is `θ / (2 L)` times the double centring of the expected pairwise coalescence times, `𝔼[C i j] = θ / (2 L) * (t̄ i· + t̄ ·j - t i j - t̄ ··)`.
nodes.title: McVean's theorem on expected genotype covariance

nodes.summary: McVean's genealogical setting for PCA, taken as the model assumption: random genotypes `Z i s` (sample `i`, locus `s`), square integrable, whose expected numbers of pairwise differences are `θ` times the expected pairwise coalescence times `coalTime i j` (neutral infinite sites, time in units of `2N` generations, `θ` the total scaled mutation rate of the `L` loci). For `θ = 0` the coalescence times are not…
nodes.title: McVean's genealogical model for PCA

nodes.summary: The expected heterozygosity `π X Y = 𝔼[hetPair (p X) (p Y)]` between populations `X` and `Y` (within population `X` when `Y = X`).
nodes.title: Expected heterozygosity between populations

nodes.summary: The number of pairwise differences `d i j = ∑ s, (Z i s - Z j s) ^ 2` (for `0`/`1` haplotypes, the number of loci at which samples `i` and `j` differ).
nodes.title: Number of pairwise differences between samples

nodes.summary: `(a - b) ^ 2 = hetPair a b - (hetPair a a + hetPair b b) / 2`.
nodes.title: Squared frequency difference via pairwise heterozygosity

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
